attBesluta.text: It is good, it stops arrows at least up to 70Lbs but gets punched hard, sometimes a arrow come in and the inside is pushed out on the other side and I experience some corners coming appart where they are glued. But serves the objective nicely.

Over all this is a good value. It has its flaws, the dark green target is hard to see in some lighting, I ended up spray painting a white target on one side which is easier for me to focus on. This looks like solid foam but its actually a foam box that is glued together around some filling materials. It functions just fine and will stop a arrow even from a hard hitting compound bow. I had one of the side seams burst so i had to glue the foam back together. Its fairly light which is both a pro and con. Pro: its light and easy to move around and put in storage when not needed, Con: it needs to be braced in place because a arrow will move it with impact. Over all I dropped it one star because of the side seam fail but its not too bad for the money.
This is a phenomenal value, you get a lot for your money.
This kit is amazing! We used it in our cargo trailer on the floor and on the walls. Great buy!
Best thing to use for strapping stuff to my trailer, I'm transporting multiple motorcycles on trailer (and other stuff) and the ability to put a strap ring where it works the best is a game changer.

Article de bonne qualité, reçu dans les délais. Dommage qu'il ne soit pas possible d'obtenir des accessoires supplémentaires qui seraient bien utiles (VEVOR ne vend pas ces accessoires supplémentaires).
A ajuns în mai puțin de o săptămână. Este compact, ușor și suficient de solid. Prinderea este standard asa ca merge cu un laser de la Bosch
Trepied fparte solid cu posibilitate de echilibrare si reglaj pe inaltime. Extrem de solid si foarte bun pentru nivela laser rotativa.

I use the tripod as a stand for a rotary laser level. The tripod is sturdy and high-quality, and it remains stable even when adjusted to its maximum height. I deducted one star because the tripod was slightly damaged during shipping, but I received compensation for the damage.
Exactly like ‹NAMN› big brands just half ‹NAMN› price. Works incredibly well
ein Hammer Offroad Wagenheber! ideal für mein Geländefahrzeug mit sehr hohen Federn trotz Hubhöhe steht er sehr stabil

Preis-Leistung Top! Ich nutze den Wagenheber hauptsächlich um Baumstämme aus der Erde zu ziehen und Wartungen an einem Minibagger durchzuführen. Die Arbeiten erledigt er Problemlos. Durch den großen Arbeitsbereich finden sich jedoch auch eine Vielzahl von anderen Anwendungsmöglichkeiten rund um Haus und Hof wie z.B schwere Holzbalken in Wage bringen. Ich möchte das Gerät als Helfer nicht mehr missen.
